title: Rio de Janeiro's "homegrown" LLM appears to be a merge of an existing model
summary: A GitHub issue exposing that Rio de Janeiro's claimed 'homegrown' LLM (Nex-N2) appears to be a merge or modification of existing open-source models, raising questions about model provenance and academic integrity in AI development.
problem_solved: Exposes potential misrepresentation of AI model origins and raises awareness about verifying model provenance claims.
why_valuable: Highlights the importance of transparency and ethical practices in AI development, especially regarding model attribution and the growing concern of 'vibe coding' in the AI community.
